messages:
fiona: hey all :wave: I'm Fiona, started today. Trying to run kubectl but my kubeconfig only shows two contexts and I don't see the 'redwood-dev' context or my namespace. Who should I ping for onboarding RBAC?
jon-infra: welcome Fiona! pinging infra to help. Quick checks first: can you paste the output of `kubectl config get-contexts` and `kubectl config view --minify --flatten`? Also what's your SSO email so we can bind the correct group.
k8s-bot: created infra-ticket #12345 for user fiona requesting namespace RoleBinding. Status: pending.
fiona: output pasted:
```
CURRENT   NAME                 CLUSTER          AUTHINFO       NAMESPACE
*         dev-eks              dev-cluster      fiona@corp
          ci                  ci-cluster        ci-sa
```
and `kubectl config view --minify --flatten` shows only the dev-eks and ci contexts, no redwood-managed context.
jon-infra: thanks. You're in the SSO group "contractor" only currently, not in `redwood-developers`. I can add a RoleBinding for your SSO email into namespace `team-fiona` for onboarding. Please confirm your SSO email.
fiona: fiona@redwood.ai
jon-infra: done — I created RoleBinding `rb-fiona-onboard` in namespace `team-fiona` and bound it to group `redwood-developers-onboard`. Should be effective in ~30s. Try `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-fiona` and `kubectl get pods -n team-fiona` after that. If still failing, run `kubectl config use-context dev-eks` then retry.
lisa-eng: small tip — if you're on mac and using our SSO plugin, run `aws sso login --profile redwood` (or `gcloud auth login` if you use GCP) before kubectl. Sometimes the auth plugin caches an old token.
k8s-bot: RoleBinding `rb-fiona-onboard` created by jon-infra. Ticket #12345 updated.
fiona: tried `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-fiona` -> yes. `kubectl get pods -n team-fiona` returns "No resources found." so looks like I have access but nothing running yet. Yay :tada:.
jon-infra: perfect. I also added you to the `#team-redwood-dev` channel and left a short DM with onboarding steps (kubecontext, namespace naming, how to request resource quotas). Ping me if you need secrets access — that'll be a separate request.
sachin-platform: welcome! I updated the onboarding doc with namespace conventions and a short checklist for setting up your local kubeconfig + SSO flow.
fiona: thanks everyone, this was super fast. Appreciate it :smile:
